descriptor_docs.sub: Sustained low-end weight (below ~400 Hz), transient excluded.
descriptor_docs.punch: Attack-to-body contrast in the 345 Hz - 950 Hz range.
descriptor_docs.click: High-frequency energy in the first ~17 ms — the beater click.
descriptor_docs.bright: Share of body energy above ~1.8 kHz.
descriptor_docs.decay: Broadband early-to-late energy ratio. Higher = faster decay (acoustic thump), lower = long sustain (808-style).
